How it works

How it works

  1. Upload a product photo – a hanger or smartphone shot is enough. VM recognizes name and product type automatically.
  2. Pick a model from the gallery or build your own with simple choices (age, body, skin tone, expression).
  3. Choose a scene – studio, street, café and more – or describe your own.
  4. Select formats and perspectives, then generate. Refine, favorite and download your shots.
  5. Press “Animate” on any image to create a product video (walk, turn, detail pan and more).

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What photos do I need?

One clear photo of the product is enough. A second back-view photo improves back perspectives.

Will my product look exactly right?

The engine is instructed to preserve colors, materials, logos and proportions faithfully. Always review before publishing – regeneration is one click.

How is usage billed?

Images count 1,000 words each (higher resolutions more), videos 1,000 words per second – the same word budget as all other VM tools.

Who is this worth it for?

Anyone who regularly needs new product imagery – from fashion shops with frequent collection changes to agencies running several catalogs at once.
